integrity_notes: All-size proof supplemented by 200 checks, including exact symbolic five-site identities and direct quadrature. The uniform all-size path tie and the general spectral Gramian reduction are prior results and excluded from the new claim. No independent validation; equivalent historic Jacobi-resultant identities may exist.
scientific_limitations: The main formula is for one coordinate actuator on any finite symmetric positive-edge weighted path, homogeneous nonnegative damping and T>0. Infinite horizon requires positive damping. The complete optimizer phase given separately assumes a five-node mirror-symmetric two-conductance path. General weighted paths are ranked by root polynomials, not by a universal threshold.
title: Exact rooted-resultant D-volumes for arbitrary weighted diffusion paths
